item.title: How to trigger a click event in JavaScript
item.description: Programmatically triggering click events is essential for automated testing, form submissions, and creating seamless user interactions. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve implemented event triggering in numerous interactive components. From my expertise, the most reliable approach is using the click() method, which simulates an actual user click with proper event propagation. This method ensures all event listeners and default behaviors execute correctly.
